description: Configure, control, and debug AutoSurg modules from VS Code.
command.dummySend: AutoSurg: Send Request To Dummy Worker
config.title: AutoSurg
config.configPath: Path to modules.yaml, relative to the workspace root when not absolute.
config.controlPython: Python executable used for the ControlPlane client.
config.webuiPort: Port of the system WebUI (HTTP/WS) used for log streaming. 0 means ControlPlane port minus 8 (default 5552).
config.debugPortBase: First port considered for temporary compute debugging. Orchestrator hot-attach uses conventional port 5684.
config.dummyNFrames: How many slots to fill with frames (--dummy-n-frames). This does NOT size the segment: capacity and max_data_size are taken verbatim from modules.yaml, so a frame key still allocates its full production ring (~512 MB with the shipped config) and only the first N slots hold frames.
config.dummyEndpointDir: Prefix for the endpoint a standalone worker binds. It is deliberately a different directory from the real system sockets, so a dummy run never collides with main.py and nothing routes to it.
config.dummyShmKeys: Override which dummy SHM keys to seed (space or comma separated). Empty derives them from the ingress modules listed in the module's depends_on.
config.dummyFrameSource: Default dummy frame source (random, random:WxH[:mono], or an absolute image/video path). Shown first in the source picker; empty means bare 'random', i.e. a production-size (1920x1080 SBS, ~2.9 MB) noise frame. Slot caps are whatever the module's modules.yaml declares - the extension only pre-checks against them.
config.dummyPreflight: Probe the dummy frame specs with the module's own interpreter before launching the worker, so an oversized or unreadable source fails in milliseconds instead of after a multi-minute model load.
config.dummyExtraArgs: Extra arguments appended verbatim to run_compute_worker.py, e.g. --shm shm_frozen_buffer:shm_frozen_buffer:16:4194304:frozen_pool for keys --dummy-shm cannot fake.
config.dummyRequestTimeoutMs: How long Send Request To Dummy Worker waits for a reply. A suspended breakpoint blocks the reply, so raise this while stepping through a handler.
config.dummyReadyTimeoutS: How long to keep pinging the standalone worker after launching it. Heavy GPU modules spend minutes in on_setup.
config.dummyConsole: Where the standalone worker's own stdout/stderr goes.
config.dummyConsole.terminal: Integrated terminal (Ctrl+C is how the dummy SHM segments get unlinked)
config.diagnosticsFolder: Folder for attach-attempt logs used by Copy Attach Diagnostics. Empty means the extension's global storage folder.
config.tensorHover: Show a tensor/image thumbnail when hovering a Python variable while the debugger is paused.
config.logView: Where to render the system log stream. Output channels cannot render ANSI colors; the terminal view shows Loguru-style colors.
